exposure: knowledge of treatment options for urinary incontinence
outcome: knowledge of treatment options for urinary incontinence
impact of urinary incontinence on sexual, social, fluid intake, and occupational functioning
cohort: 136 low-income women working in a poultry processing plant
finding: The prevalence of urinary incontinence was low (2.9%), but knowledge about the condition and its treatment options was poor.
mod_finding: Of the women who had vaginal deliveries, 86.6% had undergone episiotomy.
